title: Rule-Version Length=0 vector misclassifies a complete malformed TLV as truncated
description: Correctness review: rule_versioning.json dio_rule_version_parse_length_0 (around lines 116-124) uses wire 1300 and expect_error=truncated, claiming it needs 3+length bytes. In normal TLV arithmetic Type+Length+zero value is exactly two bytes and complete; it is invalid because the specialized option requires Length=1, i.e. wrong_length/malformed_length_0. authenticated_schc_dio.json uses malformed_rule_version_length_0 and rpl_messages.json uses invalid_schc_version_option, exposing the cross-artifact cause mismatch. Align the exact classification and add an independent structural assertion.
